goal: Find the best model at every fit-time limit on the full Chelsea + West Village data, preferring more elegant ones, from short exploration fits confirmed overnight by full fits.

tiers.name: exploration
tiers.description: A short fit to rank designs quickly: 2 chains x (100 warmup + 600 draws), about 4-10 minutes. It counts on the research frontier but is never served.

tiers.name: full
tiers.description: Full draws, the convergence gate and the 2-hour cap; full-data confirmation fits run only between 03:00 and 08:00 ET. Only these can be served.

notes: The first full-data fit that passes the gate: bath and floor slopes per building with the served features and the neighbourhood, 2 x (300 + 4,500) draws, 2,800 s, PSIS-LOO 87,334.

Calibration on the full data: short fits score too high, and the excess shrinks with the number of draws, not the warmup. Design differences come within about 25 points of the full fit's at 600 draws, and within Monte Carlo error at 1,500.
So exploration fits use 600 draws and only 100 warmup iterations; compiling costs 1 to 2 minutes of each fit and PSIS-LOO about 85 seconds.
